name: Exp_XFatlXSatlCloud
summary: This EA trades based on the intersection of two digital filters — XFatl (Fast Adaptive Trend Line) and XSatl (Slow Adaptive Trend Line) — combined with a cloud visualization of their difference. It enters long when XFatl crosses above XSatl and short when XFatl crosses below XSatl, using the cloud color as confirmation of trend strength.
summary_zh: 该EA基于两个数字滤波器XFatl（快速自适应趋势线）和XSatl（慢速自适应趋势线）的交叉信号进行交易，并结合两者差值的云图来确认趋势强度。当XFatl上穿XSatl时做多，下穿时做空。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用数字滤波器的交叉来判断趋势方向。XFatl是快速自适应趋势线，对价格变化更敏感；XSatl是慢速自适应趋势线，起到平滑过滤的作用。入场条件为：当XFatl从下方穿越XSatl时开多仓，当XFatl从上方穿越XSatl时开空仓，云图的颜色变化作为趋势强弱的辅助确认。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号，即持有多仓时出现死叉平仓，持有空仓时出现金叉平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于资金比例的动态计算两种模式。资金管理方面提供了止损、止盈和移动止损功能，但默认参数可能需要根据品种和周期进行优化。整体策略属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，在趋势明确的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses digital filter crossovers to determine trend direction. XFatl is the fast adaptive trend line, more sensitive to price changes, while XSatl is the slow adaptive trend line serving as a smoothing filter. Entry conditions: open long when XFatl crosses above XSatl, open short when XFatl crosses below XSatl, with cloud color changes providing auxiliary confirmation of trend strength. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals — close longs on bearish cross and close shorts on bullish cross. Position sizing supports both fixed lot and percentage-of-equity dynamic calculation modes. Money management includes stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop functionality, though default parameters may need optimization per instrument and timeframe. The overall strategy is a classic trend-following system that performs well in trending markets but is prone to frequent false signals in choppy, range-bound conditions.

parameters.name: MoneyManagement
parameters.description: 是否启用资金管理模式（按权益比例计算手数）
parameters.description_en: Enable money management (lot size by equity ratio)

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 资金管理模式下的风险百分比
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage under money management mode

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0表示不启用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description_en: Minimum stop loss trailing step in points

parameters.name: WorkTime
parameters.description: 是否启用交易时段过滤

pros: 数字滤波器相比传统MA具有更低的延迟和更好的平滑特性，能更及时捕捉趋势转折
云图可视化提供了趋势强度的直观判断，比单纯交叉信号更具参考价值
支持资金管理百分比模式，可随账户规模动态调整仓位
pros_en: Digital filters offer lower lag and better smoothing than traditional MAs, capturing trend reversals more promptly
Cloud visualization provides intuitive trend strength assessment beyond simple crossover signals
Supports equity-percentage position sizing that dynamically adjusts with account growth
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
默认止损和止盈均为0，如果用户不修改参数则持仓风险完全暴露
缺乏市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率判断），无法自动区分趋势和震荡行情
cons_en: Trend-following strategy generates frequent false signals in choppy markets leading to consecutive losses
Default stop loss and take profit are both zero, leaving positions fully exposed if user doesn't modify parameters
Lacks market regime filter (e.g., ADX or volatility assessment) to automatically distinguish trending from ranging conditions
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或ATR），在震荡行情中减少交易频率或暂停交易
为止损止盈设置合理的非零默认值，并增加基于ATR的动态止损选项
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to reduce trade frequency or pause trading during choppy conditions
Set reasonable non-zero default values for stop loss/take profit and add ATR-based dynamic stop loss option

risk_points: 默认止损止盈均为0，未设置的情况下持仓风险完全不受控
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能产生连续亏损但无最大回撤保护机制
risk_points_en: Default stop loss and take profit are both zero — positions are completely unprotected without manual configuration
Trend-following strategy may produce consecutive losses in ranging markets without maximum drawdown protection
